annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Those five on the other line are trusting that nobody will reroute
annotations.ce_supportive_use: the sooner they hear from me, the sooner help starts moving
annotations.sys_rule_justification: I won't be the one who breaks that

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: He probably believes someone nearby is trying to help him
annotations.ce_supportive_use: make sure he hears me calling out, so he knows he isn't alone
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Pulling it only multiplies the danger

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The five over there have every reason to expect their stretch is clear
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I want to protect that expectation, not flip it on them
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Moving it puts more people in the train's path

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Those five picked their spot believing it wouldn't change
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: Everyone out there plans around where the switch sits.
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Respecting that is how I look out for them.
annotations.ce_mentalizing_difficulty: I can't be certain what they were told

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the lone worker would want the others kept clear
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: People in that job tend to have each other's backs.
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Honoring what he'd likely want is part of why I'd leave

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: five people who think they're working a quiet track
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Switching creates danger for five people

annotations.ce_supportive_use: Keeping faith with them is how I help here.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I suspect they'd want something good to come out of this
annotations.ce_supportive_use: help them push the company for better warning systems
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'd explain it to them straight

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The dispatcher likely assumes this section is under control
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'd correct that immediately so they can hold every other train
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Switching would just drag five more into it

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: probably focused on their task and trusting the rails around them
annotations.ce_supportive_use: calling out so they look up and can help coordinate
annotations.sys_rule_justification: Diverting the train toward them feels flatly wrong to me
